purpose: Decoupled 20-hour exact-Q long solve of the K=7 beta-stratum b9 q0 cover chart, the last chart keeping stratum b9 conditional. THIS LANE MAKES NO MATHEMATICAL VERDICT; it only launches and hands off.

frozen_input_verification.method: awk built the manifest mechanically from the numbered receipt charged_input_<i>_basename/_sha256 fields; sha256sum -c

literal_launch_attempt.result: rejected by AWS before instance creation; the frozen driver parses the first positional argument as COUNT

msolve.note: installed by fleet.sh wait; NOT used by any of the three launched jobs

engines.coefficient_field: Q (characteristic 0) for jobs a and b; Q(v69) for job c

generator_sources.origin: pushed from host; differs from the frozen producer copy box/k4ray-beta-strata-20260905/strata_chart.py (7f9d0610f1e42e964155350256dc4b14bdbfb52ec379894048015dfe3281d9c1) in exactly one line, the output-root assignment, per k7-strata-gate-sol56-20260905.md

worker AMI copy; this is the exact version pinned in box/k4ray-strata-solve-20260905/source-charts.sha256, i.e. the producer version. The host's current box/lib/guided_gb.py is 95d12f5b23975e8699b634b1ba8c6f0e6fc4e24abfcd4bad2db936e1c74e9826 and was NOT used.

ring_map.declaration: positional; the .ms header names ARE the Singular variable names

asserts: chart sha256 equals the frozen value
names are exactly v0..v71 in order

watchdog.py.behaviour: polls the summed VmRSS of the whole descendant tree every 15 s, records peak, SIGKILLs the tree above the cap, and writes caprun.json continuously

caps.no_ulimit_v: deliberate: RSS, not address space, is the binding cap

jobs.route: Singular exact-Q slimgb, dp, option(redSB), short=0, full 241-row chart
jobs.inner_command: /usr/bin/time -v -o time.txt timeout -s TERM --kill-after=120 72000 nice -n 4 Singular --no-rc -q job.sing > stdout.txt 2> stderr.txt

jobs.route: Singular exact-Q std under the frozen chart bigrading; ring R=0,(v0..v71),wp(<frozen 72-weight vector>), option(redSB), short=0, full 241-row chart
exact-Q(v69) triangular pre-reduction then slimgb on the reduced system (r2 section 3, r3b section 5); ring R=(0,v69),(71 remaining vars),dp
jobs.pivots_source: k7-cofactors-sol56-r3b-20260906.md section 5, verbatim row and variable lists
jobs.PROMOTION_CAVEAT: A unit here is a unit in the localization Q(v69)[rest]. It is NOT by itself an exact-Q certificate in the source ring: the harvest lane must clear the v69-power denominators and re-close with the original Rabinowitsch generator v69*v71-1, as r2 section 3 did for b11 q0.

smoke_tests.method: parse-only truncations of the three job files, run to completion before launch

results.c_tri_qv69_slimgb: rc 0, CERT__NPARS 1, pivots 1-2 all checks 1, nnz 238 then 233

delimiters.accept_only: exit code 0, exactly one delimiter pair, body bytes exactly 31 0a, CERT__GB_SIZE 1, CERT__UNIT 1, CERT__DONE 1
delimiters.note: if size(G) > 25 the body holds lead terms only and CERT__GB_LEADS_ONLY 1 is printed; that is not a certificate
